verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible serve mode, so serving throughput is a fair axis, but the evidence never mentions continuous batching or chunked prefill. The +59% decode throughput claim comes from expert-routing prediction that overlaps SSD loads, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
